propositions: Two functions, build_model_settings() and build_usage_limits(), must be extracted from runner.py into the existing structured_run.py module to reduce runner.py below 700 lines.

build_model_settings() must be pure (no side effects); the _TEMPERATURE_WITHDRAWN_LOGGED mutation must remain inline in run() because structured_run.py is a leaf module that cannot import from runner.py at runtime.

build_usage_limits() must return a tuple of (usage_limits, req_limit, eff_max_iter) as three separate values because eff_max_iter cannot be recovered from the UsageLimits object (only max(8, eff_max_iter) is stored as tool_calls_limit).

cache_settings must be passed as an explicit parameter to build_model_settings(), not recomputed inside it, to preserve the _model_override guard that keeps cache settings None on the offline TestModel path.
The seam guard test must be updated to cover both extracted functions by adding them to hardcoded symbol lists, and all monkeypatch targets that move must be repointed in the same commit.
